/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '780,890p' app/merge_operations.py && sed -n '1,130p' app/merge_operations.py && rg -n \"derive.*path|changed.*path|rename|diff-tree|merge-base|name-status\" app/merge_operations.py app"
final_text:
CAUSE: `merge_worker` fails because `changed_paths()` treats a timed-out Git diff as “paths unavailable.” In `app/merge_test_gate.py`, `_git()` gives every Git command a fixed 15-second timeout and returns `None` on `TimeoutExpired`. `changed_paths()` runs `git diff --name-only <target>...HEAD` with Git’s default rename detection enabled. On this branch’s large diff, rename similarity checks can exceed that timeout; `changed_paths()` then returns `None`, and `_prepare_admission_snapshot()` in `app/merge_operations.py` raises “cannot derive target-relative merge paths.”

The refusal happens before oracle evaluation, so the unchanged test-gate selection or pytest run is not the cause. Retries repeat the same timed-out diff.

Recommended fix: use `--no-renames` for this changed-path inventory, since it only needs paths for admission and test selection, not rename classification. Alternatively, increase the timeout, but that leaves runtime dependent on diff size.
